news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 15%
news.body: After last week's 15% share price gain to ₹22.94, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 17x. Average forward P/E is 10x in the Banks industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 44% over the past three years.

news.title: YESBANK: New CEO And Upcoming Results Will Shape Balanced Outlook
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Yes Bank slightly to around ₹19.32 from about ₹19.55, reflecting updated assumptions on discount rate, profit margin and future P/E, while keeping revenue growth expectations broadly similar. What's in the News Yes Bank has scheduled a board meeting on April 18, 2026 to consider and approve audited standalone and consolidated financial results for Q4 and the full year ended March 31, 2026 (company filing).

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.12 (vs ₹0.78 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.12 (up from ₹0.78 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹159.3b (up 14% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹35.1b (up 44% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 22% (up from 17% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 15% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, while revenues in the Banks industry in India are expected to remain flat. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 47% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 8% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.body: Analysts have modestly revised their price target on Yes Bank to ₹20.27. This reflects updated assumptions around the discount rate, long-term revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E expectations, while keeping the core fair value estimate unchanged.

news.title: YESBANK: New CEO Appointment And Q3 Results Will Shape Balanced Outlook
news.body: Analysts have kept their price target on Yes Bank steady at ₹20.27, citing small adjustments in the discount rate, profit margin assumptions and future P/E expectations rather than a major shift in their overall view. What's in the News Yes Bank has appointed Vinay Muralidhar Tonse as Chief Executive Officer for a three year tenure, following approval from the Reserve Bank of India, after his prior role as Managing Director for Retail Business and Operations at State Bank of India up to November 30, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: Yes Bank Ltd Appoints Vinay Muralidhar Tonse as Chief Executive Officer
news.body: Yes Bank Ltd. has appointed Vinay Muralidhar Tonse as its new Chief Executive Officer (CEO) for a three-year tenure, starting from the date he officially takes charge. The appointment follows approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). Previously, Vinay Muralidhar Tonse was with the State Bank of India, where he served as Managing Director for Retail Business and Operations until November 30, 2025. The bank had been looking for new leadership to drive its growth plans following the extended term of current MD & CEO Prashant Kumar.

news.title: Yes Bank Ltd Appoints Vinay Muralidhar Tonse as Managing Director
news.body: Yes Bank Ltd. has appointed Vinay Muralidhar Tonse as its new Managing Director (MD) for a three-year tenure, starting from the date he officially takes charge. The appointment follows approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). Previously, Vinay Muralidhar Tonse was with the State Bank of India, where he served as Managing Director for Retail Business and Operations until November 30, 2025. The bank had been looking for new leadership to drive its growth plans following the extended term of current MD & CEO Prashant Kumar.

news.title: YESBANK: Upcoming Q3 Results And Subtle Assumption Shifts Will Shape Outlook
news.body: Analysts have nudged their price target on Yes Bank higher to ₹20.27 per share from ₹19.45, pointing to a slightly richer assumed fair value, a modest adjustment to the discount rate, small tweaks to revenue growth expectations, a marginally stronger profit margin, and a slightly higher future P/E multiple in their models. What's in the News Yes Bank has scheduled a board meeting for January 17, 2026 to consider and approve the unaudited standalone financial results for Q3 and the nine months ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: Yes Bank Limited Announces Resignation of Tushar Patankar as Chief Risk Officer Effective January 21, 2026
news.body: YES BANK LIMITED announced that Mr. Tushar Patankar, Chief Risk Officer, had tendered his resignation from the services of the Bank on November 12, 2025, to pursue his career aspiration. The Bank has relieved Mr. Tushar Patankar from his duties effective from close of business hours on January 21, 2026.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.30 (vs ₹0.20 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.30 (up from ₹0.20 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹41.6b (up 17% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹9.57b (up 54% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 23% (up from 18% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 16% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 1.5% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 45% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 6% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

What's in the News Yes Bank has scheduled a board meeting on January 17, 2026, to review and approve its unaudited standalone financial results for Q3 and the nine months ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: YESBANK: Rising SMBC Influence Will Pressure Shares Despite Stable Earnings Outlook
news.body: Analysts have modestly increased their price target on Yes Bank to ₹18.50 per share, reflecting slightly higher assumed discount rates and a marginally richer future earnings multiple, while keeping fair value broadly unchanged. What's in the News Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (SMBC) completed the acquisition of an additional 4.22 percent stake in Yes Bank from CA Basque Investments, raising its holding to 24.22 percent for INR 28.47 billion at INR 21.5 per share, following approvals from RBI and the Competition Commission of India (Key Developments) SMBC also completed separate deals to acquire a 2.75 percent stake from HDFC Bank and a 2.39 percent stake from ICICI Bank at INR 21.5 per share, consolidating its position as a key strategic shareholder in Yes Bank (Key Developments) A

news.title: YESBANK: Rising SMBC Control Will Pressure Shares Despite Stable Core Outlook
news.body: Analysts have modestly revised their price target on Yes Bank upward to ₹18.50 per share, reflecting stable fair value assumptions along with slightly higher discount rates and future valuation multiples that support a cautiously improved outlook. What's in the News Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (SMBC) has completed a series of transactions to raise its stake in Yes Bank to approximately 24.22 percent through multiple secondary share purchases from State Bank of India, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank and CA Basque Investments, at a price of about INR 21.5 per share (Key Developments).

news.title: YESBANK: Increased Ownership May Lead To Downside Risk Ahead
news.body: Analysts have maintained their price target for Yes Bank at ₹18.5, citing marginal improvements in profit margins and revenue growth as the primary factors behind their unchanged outlook. What's in the News Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation completed the acquisition of an additional 4.22% stake in Yes Bank Limited from CA Basque Investments, raising its ownership to 24.22% as of September 23, 2025.
